title: Sophistication in GenAI Use: Field Evidence from a Large Firm
abstract: arXiv:2608.27364v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study how sophistication in generative AI (genAI) use varies among the back-office workforce of a large firm. Using proprietary data, we observe 713,564 employee prompts and their corresponding large language model responses from nearly 4,000 back-office employees across 15 functional areas over eight months in 2025. We document three main findings. First, senior employees exhibit more sophisticated genAI use, consistent with domain expertise complementing genAI capabilities. Second, sophistication varies considerably across functions and is highest in Strategy, Digital Innovation, and Project Management, three groups that share a focus on firmwide strategic initiatives and organizational change. Third, we observe neither improvements in sophistication over time nor lasting improvements following formal AI training, suggesting that sophisticated use can be difficult to change. translated_title: 生成式人工智能使用中的复杂性：来自大型企业的实地证据
translated_abstract: 摘要：我们研究了一家大型企业后台员工中生成式人工智能（genAI）使用复杂性的差异。利用专有数据，我们观察了2025年八个月内，来自15个职能领域近4000名后台员工的713,564条员工提示及其对应的大语言模型响应。我们记录了三个主要发现。首先，高级员工表现出更复杂的生成式人工智能使用，这与领域专业知识补充生成式人工智能能力相一致。其次，复杂性在不同职能间差异显著，在战略、数字创新和项目管理三个群体中最高，这三个群体共同关注全公司战略举措和组织变革。第三，我们观察到复杂性随时间没有改善，正式人工智能培训后也没有持久改进，这表明复杂的使用可能难以改变。总之，我们的研究提供了对生成式人工智能使用复杂性的度量标准和见解。
tldr: 本研究通过大型企业后台员工的实地数据，发现高级员工和特定职能（如战略、数字创新和项目管理）在生成式人工智能使用上更复杂，且这种复杂性难以通过时间或培训改变。
en_tdlr: This study, using field data from back-office employees at a large firm, finds that senior employees and specific functions (e.g., Strategy, Digital Innovation, and Project Management) exhibit more sophisticated genAI use, which is difficult to change over time or through training.
